rows.summary: If something moves you deeply, give yourself enough curiosity to understand why before you hand it your loyalty, money, or trust.
rows.body: If something moves you deeply, give yourself enough curiosity to understand why before you hand it your loyalty, money, or trust. When Neptune sextiles Pluto, empathy and intuition can draw your attention toward the motive, history, hidden incentive, or power dynamic underneath the version of the story that first caught your heart. Learning more does not require you to become cynical about what matters to you. It gives you a chance to make sure your support is going toward the thing you actually believe in rather than the version that was easiest to sell.

rows.summary: If you keep defending something because accepting the harder truth would force you to rethink what you believed about it, that discomfort is worth paying attention to.
rows.body: If you keep defending something because accepting the harder truth would force you to rethink what you believed about it, that discomfort is worth paying attention to. When Neptune squares Pluto, hope, fear, loyalty, or idealism can make an unequal dynamic easier to justify because seeing the power clearly threatens the story you would rather keep. You do not have to distrust everything you care about. Notice which question you keep avoiding, who benefits from the current arrangement, and what becomes harder to excuse once you stop protecting the version you wanted to believe.

rows.summary: Sometimes understanding the deeper reason behind someone’s behavior makes you more compassionate without making the behavior any more acceptable.
rows.body: Sometimes understanding the deeper reason behind someone’s behavior makes you more compassionate without making the behavior any more acceptable. When Neptune trines Pluto, emotional insight can help you see the history, fear, grief, desire, or power underneath a situation without forcing you to choose between empathy and clear judgment. Let the fuller context change your understanding, but do not use understanding as a reason to abandon the boundary the situation still requires. You can see why something happened and still decide it cannot continue.
